name: google-ads-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for Google Ads: GAQL queries, resource schema and catalog, recommendations, keyword planning and forecasts, change history, multi-account via MCC.

tools.name: google_ads_list_accessible_customers
tools.description: List every customer_id the OAuth user has direct access to

tools.name: google_ads_list_customer_clients
tools.description: Walk the MCC hierarchy and return every child account

tools.name: google_ads_query
tools.description: Run a GAQL query against a specific customer account

tools.name: google_ads_describe_resource
tools.description: Schema (fields, metrics, segments) for a GAQL resource

tools.name: google_ads_list_resources
tools.description: Return the full catalog of GAQL resources

tools.name: google_ads_recommendations
tools.description: Read Google's optimization recommendations for a customer account

tools.name: google_ads_keyword_ideas
tools.description: Generate keyword ideas with search volume, competition and CPC estimates

tools.name: google_ads_keyword_historical_metrics
tools.description: Historical monthly search-volume and competition metrics for specific keywords

tools.name: google_ads_keyword_forecast_metrics
tools.description: Forecast KPIs for a proposed keyword plan

tools.name: google_ads_change_events
tools.description: Audit trail of who changed what, last 30 days

tools.name: google_ads_change_status
tools.description: Lightweight last-modified change tracker per resource

developer_token.title: Developer Token
developer_token.description: Google Ads API developer token, issued in the Ads API Center under your manager account. Basic access is enough for reporting; keyword planning may need it too.

client_id.title: OAuth2 Client ID
client_id.description: Desktop-app OAuth2 client_id from a Google Cloud project with the Google Ads API enabled.

client_secret.title: OAuth2 Client Secret
client_secret.description: OAuth2 client_secret paired with the client_id.

refresh_token.title: OAuth2 Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Long-lived refresh_token for the adwords scope, generated once by an admin user of the manager account.

login_customer_id.title: Login Customer ID (MCC)
login_customer_id.description: 10-digit customer ID of the manager account. Every child account linked under it is queryable.

api_version.title: API Version
api_version.description: Google Ads API version to target, e.g. v25. Optional; the server has its own default.
